newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Ganz terminates China gold deal.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Ganz terminates China gold deal.

text.p: Ganz Technologies Bhd said on Saturday that it has decided not to proceed with its proposed goldmine investment in China.
In a statement, it said various conditions which determine the viability of the proposed investment has not being resolved to the satisfaction of the company.
Ganz, a glove maker, had in February entered into an agreement to acquire a 50 percent stake in China's Harbin Classic Mines Machinery Co Ltd for $2 million.
Harbin Classic has concessions to mine for gold at two sites in the Ganzi Tibetan autonomous region, west of Sichuan province in China.
The mines are estimated to have extractable reserves of eight tons of gold.
Ganz had said that the proposed investment would enable it to reduce dependence on its core latex glove business.
